sentences: Stable hypergraph matching generalizes matching to groups of participants whose preferences may block a proposed solution.
For unimodular hypergraphs, existence results guarantee a stable matching under the source's assumptions.
The question asks whether one can actually find such a matching in polynomial time.
Network hypergraphs provide a particularly interesting structured case.

The project separates a mathematical existence guarantee from an efficient construction, with motivation from allocation problems where compatible groups must remain stable against mutually preferred alternatives.
